headline: San Diego Mosque Hero Dad 👨‍👨‍👧‍👦💪 SHINES ☀️🦸 in Deadly Teen Attack 💥😱
text: Security Guard Amin Abdullah 👨‍👨‍👧‍👦🛡️ a father-of-eight 💪🍆 and shining light ☀️✨ was HAILED 🗣️🙌 as a TOTAL HERO 🦸‍♂️🌟 after stopping a HATE CRIME 💢🔫 rampage at San Diego mosque 🕌💥! This brave dude 🧔‍♂️💪 took bullets for the crew 😤🩸 saving lives like a BOSS 🏆🔥 while two teenage attackers 🤡👦🔫 went full self-own 💀🚗 after offing themselves blocks away! The mom of one kid 📞😭 snitched to cops 🚔 that her son ran away 🏃‍♂️💨 with his buddy and might be SUICIDAL ☠️ but instead they turned the mosque into a BLOODY MESS 🩸🕌 before popping themselves! Abdullah and two worshippers Mansour Kaziha 🧔🌿 and Nader Awad 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦📚 got killed but this security legend 🛡️👑 who worked there over a decade 🕰️❤️ was the real MVP 🏆🌟 always smiling 😊🤝 greeting EVERYONE from homeless folks 🏠💔 to kids and elders 👶👴 making sure they're A-OK ✅! Friends called him the NICEST MAN you'll ever meet 😍🫂 a true MARTYR 🕊️🔥 and courageous protector 🛡️💥 who put himself on the LINE even in his LAST MOMENTS 🕰️😢! The mosque hailed him as a COURAGEOUS MAN who didn't stop protecting the community 🕌🛡️ while online fundraiser went BRRRRR 💰🚀 raising over $1.6M 🤑🍆 for his eight kids! Police Chief Scott Wahl 🚔🗣️ said 'his actions were HEROIC 🦸‍♂️💯 undoubtedly he SAVED LIVES today' 🔥🙌 and the attack was fueled by HATE RHETORIC 💢🗣️ making it a full-on HATE CRIME 🚫😡! Cair-SD spokeswoman Tazheen Nizam 👩‍💼☕ spilled that Amin was LOVED by EVERYBODY 😍🌟 stood day after day with a smile 😊 welcoming kids to school 📚👧 and was a SHINING LIGHT ☀️✨ a TRUE HERO 🦸‍♂️🕊️! Friend Shaykh Uthman Ibn Farooq 🧔‍♂️🕌 said he wanted to DEFEND the INNOCENT 🛡️💪 so he became a security guard and Sam Hamideh 👋😊 remembered him for KINDNESS 🤝❤️ always making sure random folks off the street were OK ✅ even if homeless or elderly! The other victims Kaziha who kept the grounds and store tidy 🌿🏪 and Awad whose wife teaches at the school 📚👩‍🏫 were also lost but Abdullah's bravery prevented WORSE carnage 💥🛡️! This dad-of-eight hero 🏠💪 and community legend 🌟🕌 will be remembered forever as the ultimate protector 🛡️🔥 who took one for the team even when bullets flew! Rest in power Amin ☀️🕊️ your light still shines bright ✨🙏!
